biggest_catch: You won't see a dollar for a long time: your friend must keep their account open and in good standing for a full 90 days, and only then does the $25 get deposited (within 30 days after day 90). If your friend closes the account early or their loans fall behind, you earn nothing.
catches: Referred member must be new to RadiFi (not a current member, primary or joint, and not an account owner in the past 12 months), 18+, and meet membership eligibility.
Friend must open a RadiFi Basic Savings account with a $5 minimum balance and pay the one-time $5 membership fee.
Friend must keep the account open and in good standing for at least 90 days after account opening.
Referral must be submitted to RadiFi on the official referral form BEFORE the friend joins and within the same calendar year; submissions after the friend has already joined do not qualify.
Rewards deposited into the primary savings of both the referring and referred member within 30 days after the friend's account has been open 90 days and all requirements are met.
Referring members may earn multiple rewards (no stated cap); self-referrals and RadiFi employees/officials/volunteers are excluded.
Rewards may be reported to the IRS as dividends and may be subject to tax.
RadiFi may modify or terminate the program at any time without prior notice (rewards earned before termination are honored).

steps: Submit the official RadiFi referral form with your friend's contact information before they join.
A RadiFi representative contacts your friend to complete the referral process.
Your friend (new to RadiFi, 18+) opens a Basic Savings account ($5 minimum) and pays the $5 membership fee.
Your friend keeps the account open and in good standing for 90 days.
Your $25 reward is deposited into your primary savings account within 30 days after your friend's 90th day.
timing: Referrer's $25 deposited within 30 days after the referred member's account has been open at least 90 days (so ~4 months after account opening at the earliest).
